cases.input: A cloud invoice has a discount, reserved-capacity effects, tagged project usage and untagged usage.
cases.expect: One project-axis run retains invoice allowance identity, allocates tagged usage, routes unused reservation by policy, exposes untagged residual and reconciles to the source amount.

cases.input: The same invoice is allocated by a separate service-to-product rule.
cases.expect: The product run reconciles independently and is explicitly non-additive with the project run.

cases.input: Reserved capacity exceeds measured covered usage.
cases.expect: The unused share is charged to the declared shared pool, allocated by a separate rule or materialized as residual.

cases.input: Allocation weights total 1.08 and no residual or correction exists.
cases.expect: The run is rejected because weights exceed one and conservation fails.

cases.input: A usage-based run omits whether its meter population is complete.
cases.expect: The run is rejected because base population and completeness are mandatory.

cases.input: Invoice components are converted independently before allocation, producing inconsistent rounding.
cases.expect: The run is rejected; allocation must occur in source currency before translated results are derived.

cases.input: An analytical allocation is treated as a ledger posting and a later correction overwrites the run.
cases.expect: Both actions are rejected; posting requires a separate authorized journal entry and correction requires a successor run.
